scope: Dream provider batching, concept/facet provenance and source disposition
rationale: Issues #88 and #89 require context isolation before model interpretation and persisted outcomes before archival. Historical Python fixtures remain unchanged.
runtime: One bounded session per provider snapshot. Pending sessions rotate using the last committed persistence audit. Complete provider request and response budgets still cap split sessions. Dream-created concepts are series-scoped, and facets require exact selected source IDs.
additions: Provider prompts disclose session context, story viewpoint and source claim applicability
Persistence audits include input_dispositions with committed successor IDs, explicit discard reasons, or deferred reasons
coverage_audit may return discarded_memories with a selected memory_id and bounded nonempty reason; explicit user authority is protected
corrections: Unknown crystal source IDs reject the whole candidate instead of silently shrinking its evidence set
Input snapshots are revalidated in the audited transaction
Unsupported inputs remain pending and only fully consumed sessions become dreamed
Drain progress counts committed archival, and zero-progress batches yield a truthful pending outcome
